paraphrase: Owner framework commitment: At the selected world w, (1) every candidate individual with causal power at w is concrete, and (2) every individual that causes anything at w is concrete. 'Concrete' has the adopted sense of #1103 (DEF-CONCRETE-ESSE-IN-RE: having esse in re), which is not defined through causal power; the Lean proposition takes the concreteness predicate as a parameter, and an intended instantiation supplies that sense. Power is a capacity that need not be exercised. The direct outgoing-causation clause is retained independently, not inferred through an assumed exercise-to-power interface. With abstract/concrete disjointness, these clauses exclude abstract powers and outgoing abstract causation. No materiality, spatial location, concrete-to-power converse, inability to be caused, existential coverage, or necessity is included.
note: Owner formulation, not a source claim or established metaphysical truth. The Lean declaration defines the two-clause proposition; it does not prove either clause. The concreteness sense was fixed by the owner on #1103 (2026-11-06): https://github.com/moritzbrantner/truth-core/issues/1103#issuecomment-6683616439. The proposition does not use exhaustiveness; for the adopted sense exhaustiveness is separately derived from excluded middle (CONCRETE-ABSTRACT-ESSE-DICHOTOMY). See docs/notes/causal-power-concreteness.md and docs/notes/concrete-abstract.md. No argument/result or root closure is registered.
